summary: This clinical research study looks at different doses of the drug semaglutide in people with type 2 diabetes and overweight. Type 2 diabetes is a long-term condition affecting how the body handles blood sugar. Participants in the study receive either the study medicine as an injection under the skin or a placebo, which is an inactive dummy treatment. The trial has a status of Completed and is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S.
